definitions.explanation: Fitting or right for a particular situation, purpose, or person.

examples.japanese: {適切|てきせつ}な{言葉|ことば}を{選|えら}んでください。
{適切|てきせつ}な{対応|たいおう}をお{願|ねが}いします。
この{場合|ばあい}、{何|なに}が{適切|てきせつ}ですか。
examples.english: What is appropriate in this case?

notes:
{適切|てきせつ} is a na-adjective meaning appropriate or suitable.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {適切|てきせつ}に (appropriately)
- Noun modifier: {適切|てきせつ}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {適切|てきせつ}な{判断|はんだん} (appropriate judgment)
- {適切|てきせつ}な{処置|しょち} (appropriate measures)
- {適切|てきせつ}に{対応|たいおう}する (respond appropriately)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {適当|てきとう}: suitable; random/half-hearted (careful: has two meanings!)
- {適切|てきせつ}: appropriate (always positive)
- ふさわしい: befitting, suitable
